Command.Comment: RAGIN CORE positive mTLS probe loopback

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo MKTEMP
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
echo CERTFILES
if [ -d /etc/ragin/tls ]; then
  for f in /etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt /etc/ragin/tls/server.crt /etc/ragin/tls/server.key; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo CERT_EXISTS=$f; fi
  done
fi
echo OPENSSL_SCLIENT_CORE_LOOPBACK
if command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ATTEMPT_OPENSSL_S_CLIENT"
  if openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:8443 \
    -CAfile /etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt \
    -cert /etc/ragin/tls/server.crt \
    -key /etc/ragin/tls/server.key \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "$TMPDIR/s_client_loopback.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo S_CLIENT_EXIT=0
  else
    echo S_CLIENT_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- brief output head ---"
  head -n 80 "$TMPDIR/s_client_loopback.txt"
else
  echo OPENSSL_NOT_PRESENT
fi
echo DONE
